# The Mirror
> The Mirror is a UK news publisher covering breaking news, politics, sport, entertainment, lifestyle, money, and opinion.

The site publishes fast-moving daily coverage across UK and world news, football and other sports, celebrity and TV reporting, consumer and personal finance advice, and specialist topic hubs including royals, crime, health, and travel.

## News
- [News](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/): Main news hub for breaking stories, analysis, and major UK and global developments.
- [UK News](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/uk-news/): UK-focused reporting on public affairs, incidents, policy, and national headlines.
- [World News](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/): International news coverage, conflicts, diplomacy, and major overseas events.
- [US News](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/us-news/): US politics, breaking stories, and American current affairs coverage.
- [Politics](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/politics/): UK political reporting, party news, government policy, and Westminster analysis.
- [Weird News](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/weird-news/): Unusual stories, oddities, and offbeat news from the UK and abroad.

## UK Topics
- [Royal Family](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/royals/): News and features on the British royal family and royal events.
- [Crime](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/crime): Crime reporting, court cases, policing, and criminal investigations.
- [Weather](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/weather): Forecasts, severe weather updates, and climate-related UK news.
- [Traffic and Travel](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/uk-news/traffic-travel): Road, rail, airport, and disruption updates affecting UK travel.
- [Education](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/education/): Schools, universities, exams, and education policy reporting.
- [Obituaries](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/obituaries/): Death notices, tributes, and retrospectives on notable figures.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/): Main sport hub with live coverage, results, comment, and analysis.
- [Football](https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/): Football news, match coverage, transfers, and league updates.
- [Boxing](https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/boxing/): Fight news, results, rankings, and coverage of major boxing events.
- [Formula 1](https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/formula-1/): Formula 1 race news, driver updates, and championship coverage.
- [Tennis](https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/tennis/): Tennis tournament news, player updates, and match reporting.
- [Golf](https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/golf/): Golf news, tournament coverage, and player-focused reporting.
- [Other Sports](https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/other-sports/): Coverage of sports beyond football, boxing, motorsport, and tennis.

## Football
- [Premier League](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/premier-league): Premier League news, fixtures, transfers, and club-focused coverage.
- [Manchester United FC](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/manchester-united-fc): Manchester United news, transfer updates, and match reaction.
- [Liverpool FC](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/liverpool-fc): Liverpool news, squad updates, and transfer reporting.
- [Arsenal FC](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/arsenal-fc): Arsenal coverage including transfers, fixtures, and team news.
- [Chelsea FC](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/chelsea-fc): Chelsea news, manager updates, and transfer developments.
- [Manchester City FC](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/manchester-city-fc): Manchester City reporting on matches, transfers, and title races.
- [Transfer News](https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/transfer-news/): Football transfer rumours, confirmed deals, and window analysis.

## Entertainment
- [3am](https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/): Entertainment and celebrity hub covering showbiz, gossip, and TV stories.
- [Celebrity News](https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/celebrity-news/): Celebrity reporting, interviews, and entertainment industry updates.
- [TV News](https://www.mirror.co.uk/tv/): Television news, soap coverage, scheduling, and presenter updates.
- [Films](https://www.mirror.co.uk/film/): Film news, reviews, trailers, and movie industry coverage.
- [Music](https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/music-news/): Music news, artist updates, releases, and live performance coverage.
- [Showbiz](https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/): Broad entertainment reporting across celebrities, TV, and pop culture.

## Lifestyle
- [Lifestyle](https://www.mirror.co.uk/lifestyle/): Lifestyle hub covering food, family, relationships, and everyday living.
- [Health](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/health/): Health reporting, NHS stories, medical advice, and wellness coverage.
- [Travel](https://www.mirror.co.uk/travel/): Travel news, destination guides, airline updates, and holiday advice.
- [Food & Drink](https://www.mirror.co.uk/lifestyle/food-drink/): Recipes, restaurant stories, supermarket news, and cooking features.
- [Family](https://www.mirror.co.uk/lifestyle/family/): Parenting, family life, and household-focused features and advice.
- [Sex & Relationships](https://www.mirror.co.uk/lifestyle/sex-relationships/): Relationship advice, dating stories, and personal life features.

## Money
- [Money](https://www.mirror.co.uk/money/): Personal finance, consumer affairs, savings, and household money news.
- [Cost of Living](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/cost-of-living): Coverage of bills, inflation, wages, and affordability pressures.
- [Benefits](https://www.mirror.co.uk/money/benefits/): Benefits guidance, eligibility changes, and welfare payment updates.
- [Savings and Banking](https://www.mirror.co.uk/money/saving-banking/): Savings rates, bank changes, and practical money management coverage.
- [Mortgages and Homeowners](https://www.mirror.co.uk/money/mortgages-homeowners/): Mortgage rates, housing costs, and homeowner finance updates.
- [Pensions](https://www.mirror.co.uk/money/pensions/): Pension policy, retirement planning, and state pension reporting.
- [Shopping and Deals](https://www.mirror.co.uk/money/shopping-deals/): Consumer deals, product discounts, and retail savings coverage.

## Opinion and Features
- [Opinion](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/politics/opinion/): Comment pieces and editorial perspectives on politics and current affairs.
- [Features](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/features/): Long-form features, interviews, and in-depth human-interest reporting.
- [Investigations](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/investigations/): Investigative journalism and deeper reporting on major issues.
- [Mirror More Hopeful](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/mirror-more-hopeful/): Positive and uplifting stories highlighting community and resilience.
- [Notebook](https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/politics/): Political commentary and analysis from Mirror writers and contributors.

## Puzzles and Utilities
- [Puzzles](https://www.mirror.co.uk/games/): Games and puzzle hub including daily brainteasers and casual play.
- [Crosswords](https://www.mirror.co.uk/games/crosswords/): Crossword puzzles and related word game content.
- [Sudoku](https://www.mirror.co.uk/games/sudoku/): Daily Sudoku puzzles and number-based brainteasers.
- [Horoscopes](https://www.mirror.co.uk/lifestyle/horoscopes/): Daily horoscope content and astrology features by zodiac sign.
- [Newsletter Sign Up](https://www.mirror.co.uk/newsletter-preference-centre/): Manage newsletter subscriptions across news, sport, and lifestyle topics.
